title: Atom spectra of symmetric monoidal abelian categories and classification of subcategories
summary: We extend the classification results for torsion classes and torsion-free classes in the category of finitely generated modules over a commutative noetherian ring to suitable symmetric monoidal closed noetherian abelian categories. Our main tool is the orbit atom spectrum, defined as the quotient of Kanda's atom spectrum by the action induced by tensoring with invertible objects. We prove that, under natural tensor-theoretic assumptions, several classes of subcategories collapse to Serre subcategories or torsion-free classes.
